name: Image Database Manager (PyQt5)
description: Offline PyQt5 catalog for Windows and OS deployment images stored on the PXE server: search, filter, and jump straight to the right image folder.
longDescription: A local desktop tool for refurbishment teams managing OS images on a PXE file share. Technicians maintain an offline JSON catalog of hardware profiles: brand, model, form factor, and Windows version: with image readiness status. The app renders a sortable, filterable table, resolves on-disk folders using multiple naming-pattern strategies, and opens the matching path in the file explorer for fast access during imaging workflows. PIN-gated edits, persistent settings, and path validation keep the catalog reliable when share layouts vary between batches.
features: Offline JSON catalog of PXE-hosted Windows/OS image records
Brand, model, form factor, Windows version, and image-status fields
Sortable, filterable table for quick lookup during refurb workflows
Multiple folder naming strategies to match inconsistent share layouts
Double-click to open the resolved image folder in the file explorer
Add, edit, and delete catalog entries with PIN-protected changes
Configurable brands, device types, Windows versions, and share locations
highlights: Gives technicians one offline index of every OS image on the PXE share
Tolerates messy real-world folder naming with explicit pattern matching
challenges: PXE image shares grow quickly and folder names rarely follow one convention, making manual lookup slow during high-volume refurb.
solutions: Structured offline catalog with flexible path resolution, validation before filesystem access, and a desktop UI tuned for warehouse-floor speed.
security: Validate JSON and paths before filesystem access
Normalise paths to reduce traversal risk from untrusted catalog edits
Open external file managers only after existence checks
Protect catalog edits with PIN-gated access
